title: Kuldra Boss Fight IL Speedrun (Duo Legit 7:45)
author: Yo-_-HAM
description:
Yo-_-HAM and SnaggleToothBeast duo we unofficially ran a legit full mechanics boss fight and our pure combat time was 7:45 to heart kill and our full boss only encounter RTA is 8:25
0:00 - Video Start
0:02 - Boss Intro & Phase 1
1:54 - Phase 2 (Pylons & Cannons)
4:08 - Phase 3 (Final Catapult)
6:57 - Phase 4 (Heart Attack & De-wormer)
7:47 - Time to go (Heart HP = 0)
8:27 - Cutscenes over teleported back to Commander (outro)

[Yo-_-HAM Gear Setup]
• Weapon: Dragon Scimitar 
• Armor: Dragon Armor/Ancestral Hat for stamina regen
• Cape/Jewelry: Obsidian Cape, Unholy Symbol, Amulet of Strength

[SnaggleToothBeast Gear Setup]
• Weapon: Dragon Scimitar
• Armor: Dragon/Rune Armor
• Cape/Jewelry: Obsidian Cape, Unholy Symbol, Amulet of Strength


[Inventory & Strategy Notes]
• Key Consumables: Whetstones, Lesser Attack Potions,  Food & Drink that give Heath regen
• Strat: Air enchantment is the main spell we use for quicker attack speeds throughout the fight  as for powering up pylons and making orbs the goal was to constantly keep orbs being made while fighting the dragon hatchlings and split which elements we get infused with to power the pylons accordingly. Once we made it to the heart we cast confuse on 1 heart worm on either side of the heart to keep them from attacking us while we annihilate the hearts HP other notable spells used would be Phase Dash / Surge to draw aggro and get around fast, Tempest shield for blocking damage I cast Vengeance to reflect back major damage to hatchlings if I miss a parry or block.
